verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no official Portkey SDK. The only related evidence (portkey-docs-26) describes reusing OpenAI's own Python/Node.js SDKs by changing the base URL and adding headers. That is a third-party SDK compatibility workaround, which is adjacent and not Portkey's own official SDK. The `npx @portkey-ai/gateway` package runs the gateway and is not a client SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
